assumptions.duplicate_contact_identity: duplicate contact IDs are reported as ambiguous and do not receive deterministic resolution selections
assumptions.invalid_contact_input: contact-like inputs missing required contention identity, station, or timing fields are blocked for operator review instead of being silently dropped

assumptions.default_reduced_capacity_requirement: when configured, reduced-capacity packing may use a declared default contact capacity requirement for contacts without explicit per-contact capacity demand
assumptions.duplicate_contact_id: duplicate contact IDs are blocked before contention allocation to preserve deterministic identity joins
assumptions.effective_allocation_status: effective_allocation_status reflects whether allocated rows are usable after policy classification
assumptions.invalid_contact_input: contact-like inputs missing required allocation identity, station, or timing fields are blocked for operator review instead of being silently dropped
assumptions.resource_filter: optional resource summaries suppress unavailable resource contacts before station allocation
assumptions.returned_allocated_contacts: returned contacts exclude allocated rows whose approval policy classification is blocked_by_policy

assumptions.duplicate_affected_contact_identity: duplicate affected-contact row IDs are suffixed deterministically while preserving contact_id
